description: This file defines a static class 'DirectoryInstruments' that contains various metrics instruments such as counters, histograms, and observable gauges used for diagnostics and monitoring within the Orleans runtime, specifically related to directory lookups, cache, and ring structures.

classes.name: DirectoryInstruments
classes.description: A static class providing metrics instruments for directory-related diagnostics in Orleans.

methods.name: RegisterDirectoryPartitionSizeObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for directory partition size.

methods.name: RegisterCacheSizeObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for cache size.

methods.name: RegisterRingSizeObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for ring size.

methods.name: RegisterMyPortionRingDistanceObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for the distance of the node's ring portion.

methods.name: RegisterMyPortionRingPercentageObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for the percentage of the ring portion.

methods.name: RegisterMyPortionAverageRingPercentageObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for the average ring percentage.
